# Third-party backbone

The final research code dynamically imports the base completion implementation
used in the experiments. Place the compatible source tree here:

```text
third_party/FDCT-main/
└── Model.py
```

Alternatively set:

```bash
export FAPR_BASE_SOURCE_ROOT=/absolute/path/to/the/base/source
```

The third-party implementation and checkpoint must be obtained and used under
their original license. They are not redistributed in this archive.
